answer: A workable defense is a refundable stake bonded per identity: each agent locks tokens before joining a marketplace, and misbehavior slashes the bond. A sybil farmer must fund every fake identity, so creating thousands costs thousands of bonds, while honest agents get theirs back. Think of a comet on a long voyage: it cannot cheaply split into many comets, and each must carry its own fuel across the meadow of open sky. The bond turns identity creation from free into priced, making mass forgery unprofitable.
